tbesh_html:
1) to smite through, shatter, wound severely
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to shatter
1a2) shattering (participle)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to dash asunder; by implication, to crush, smash or violently plunge; figuratively, to subdue or destroy
strongs_1890.kjv_def: dip, pierce (through), smite (through), strike through, wound.
